top_creatures.label: Threat-swap guardian
top_creatures.why: The boss keeps its target until a challenger has 1.1x threat in melee or 1.3x at range, so the fight has a readable switch rule. Behaviour checked in code; silhouette not in box.
top_creatures.keep: Sticky target; the two thresholds; sorted threat list.
top_creatures.change: 3-attacker cap; visible swap tell (ring and sound); guard and parry feed threat.

top_creatures.label: Stacked-rank warden
top_creatures.why: Elite and world-boss ranks scale health and damage through separate config rates, so one template reads as five tiers.
top_creatures.keep: Five-step rank ladder with separate HP and damage multipliers.
top_creatures.change: Rank bands are zone data fields (cap, respawn, grace), only three steps; our own names.

top_creatures.label: Phase-band tyrant
top_creatures.why: An HP-band row fires once the boss crosses a percent band, with a repeat range; phases are rows, not code.
top_creatures.keep: HP band plus timer as data rows.
top_creatures.change: Our event names; phase bar at 375 wide; finisher beat on the last band.

top_creatures.label: Plated crawler
top_creatures.why: Scorpid family gives a low, plated, wide read; silhouette is a guess from the family name, to be judged.
top_creatures.keep: The low plated read at range.
top_creatures.change: Our own anatomy and palette; behaviour not read so none copied.

top_creatures.label: Long-stride runner
top_creatures.why: Tallstrider family implies a tall, long-legged read; silhouette and behaviour not read.
top_creatures.keep: Height and leg length as the read at range.
top_creatures.change: No bird shape; our own build.

top_creatures.label: Flying coil
top_creatures.why: Wind serpent family implies a long aerial body; silhouette and behaviour not read.

top_creatures.label: Gear brute
top_creatures.why: Mechanical family is grouped with elementals in one spell-targeting mask, so one spell hits both groups; a clean group-mask idea.
top_creatures.keep: The group mask idea (one bitmask per spell target group).
top_creatures.change: Our group names and a sound cue; no mechanical look copied.

top_creatures.label: Demon bruiser
top_creatures.why: Doomguard sits in the demon family group of five; heavy build implied by name only.
top_creatures.keep: Heavy build inside the demon group.
top_creatures.change: Our own horns and colour; behaviour not read.

looks.label: Con colour ladder
looks.technique: Five colour bands from the level gap between player and mob: red at +5 or more, orange at +3, yellow near even, green above grey, grey when trivial. Readability technique; use with a non-colour icon too.

looks.label: Seven-step quality ladder
looks.technique: Fixed tier steps, one colour word each in the comments; the server sends the tier, the client draws it. Make our own palette.

originals.name: Threat Pivot
originals.idea: Boss swaps target only when a challenger clearly beats the current one; the swap is telegraphed.
originals.keep: Sorted threat list; sticky victim; 1.1x melee and 1.3x ranged switch rule.
originals.change: 3-attacker cap; visible swap ring and sound; guard and parry feed threat.

originals.name: Con Read
originals.idea: Five colour bands on each enemy nameplate by power gap, so the player reads danger before the fight.
originals.keep: Five bands by gap; the gap is the only input.
originals.change: Bands on our power gap; icon as well as colour for colour-blind players; 375-wide nameplates.

originals.name: Elite Roll Reveal
originals.idea: Elite kills pay out a roll reveal with a rarity sound, on top of the extra XP.
originals.change: The extra is a roll reveal, not only XP; our own sound.

originals.name: Rank Ladder
originals.idea: Mobs come in ranks with separate HP and damage rates, set in zone data.
originals.keep: Separate HP and damage rates per rank.
originals.change: Three steps; rates are zone data fields (cap, respawn, grace), not config.

originals.name: Settlement Guards
originals.idea: Guard NPCs on continents are classed by a rule (faction masks, waypoint movement, not a service NPC), not placed by hand.
originals.change: Guards answer a call for help within a fixed radius; our own rule text.

originals.name: Gather Race Zone
originals.idea: Both sides collect tokens; the first to the number takes the zone and a team buff.
originals.keep: First to the number takes the zone.
originals.change: Decay on the other side and a contest window; no hard reset.

originals.name: Threshold Set Stack
originals.idea: Each extra matching piece unlocks the next bonus; removing a piece steps the bonus down.
originals.change: Fix the skill-gate count mismatch; show the next threshold on a 375-wide badge.

originals.name: Boss Phase Rows
originals.idea: Boss phases are data rows: HP band plus timer triggers an action.
originals.change: Our event names; phase bar; finisher beat on the last band.
